text_block_list.text:
It's a new year, and Смарт Фалкон and I
decide to
visit a shrine together.
However, she seems
different from her
normal self...
Mumble, mumble. Mumble, mumble, mumble, mumble...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Oh, was I speaking out loud?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That's no good... wishes don't come true
if you
say them out loud. Anyway, come
on, Trainer! Put
your hands together and
get praying!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: ...Murmur, murmur.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Sneaking a sideways glance at her as she
prays
earnestly, I feel her extraordinary
amount of
determination.

Struck by her earnestness, I decide that
my own
prayer should be for...
All righty! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: All righty! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: All righty! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Now that we've prayed, there's
something else I'd
like to take care of.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We need to talk about plans for this
year—my
senior year.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I already have a rough outline of how we
should
approach senior year.
choice_data_list:
Let's stay the course and keep putting out
results.

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон has been outstanding in
her classic
year. I tell her that the plan is
to win the February
Stakes and proceed
slow and steady through her
senior year.
However...

Sorry, but that's not gonna cut it. If I just
"stay
the course" and go "slow and
steady," it won't be
enough!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If we just stick to the same pace, I won't
be able
to reach new heights.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: That's why...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take first in every one of my

senior-year goal races!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And not just races that I can comfortably
win. I'm
talking about winning G1 races!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
First the February Stakes. Then the Teio
Sho, the
JBC Classic, the Champions
Cup...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And finally, the Tokyo Daishoten at the
end of
the year!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I wanna announce my intent to win all of
them!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The races she mentions are all ones I was
planning
to enter her in, and of course,
no matter the race,
we should always
aim for the top spot. But even
so...
choice_data_list:
Why do you want to announce that to
everyone?

text_block_list.text:
In the past, Смарт Фалкон's main focus
has been
on taking center stage at
winning concerts—not
on victory for its
own sake. If that's changed,
there has to
be a reason.

Because I want everyone to know that
there's an
Umadol out there who's crazy
fast on dirt!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I've been trying to make
dirt racing
more popular by just doing
what I normally do.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That's how we reached the hype we saw
at last
year's Tokyo Daishoten. But it's
not going to get
us any further.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If I really want to aim for the top—to
give a
performance that can even match
the Arima
Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I have to get more and more attention! I
have to
become more and more amazing!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Like—I know! I have to be like the
"otherworldly"
Сайленс Судзука!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Wow... She's so amazing. I'm gonna be
just like
her!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Смарт Фалкон has
always seen
something of her own ideal
Umadol in Silence
Suzuka.

The path she forges all by herself... Her

overwhelming speed that captures
everyone's
attention... They've always
been a beacon for
Falcon to aspire to.

I'll soar to a level beyond "turf racing" or
"dirt
racing," and become everyone's
number one!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I need you to be prepared as well,
Trainer.
Prepared to walk the
treacherous road ahead of
us...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And reach the top together! Let's take
the world
by storm!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If she goes ahead with proclaiming her
intention
to win all those highly
competitive G1 races,
there will be no
turning back.

However, since the day I chose to share
her
dream of becoming a top Umadol by
running on
dirt... my conviction has never
faltered!
choice_data_list: Let's take the world by storm!

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
First place for every race! Let's make this

resolution a reality!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
